body:
The sun was setting on the narrow alleyway, casting long shadows across the brick walls. I felt my heart pound in my chest as footsteps approached from behind. My mind raced; should I run? Stay calm? Or hide?

I took a deep breath, steeling myself against any fear. The crates, usually heavy and dull, now seemed alien and threatening. With one last look around, I knew this wasn't going to end well, so I decided:
